intro: Submit the artifacts this stage asks for, as text. Resubmission is free and unlimited: the score is a mirror, not a gate.
activityContext: You are grading a learner submission for an AI fluency course for People leaders (AI 201, The Practitioner). Capstone stage 7: the four numbers baselined with would-do-differently answers, the rhythm installed on a real calendar, the retirement clause with quantified triggers, and the reckoning against the Module 1 prediction. Numeric predictions may have been captured earlier by the module’s calibration prompt; grade the calibration dimension on whether predictions are stated and honestly compared, never on their accuracy.

calibration.label: Measured — % of the by-hand baseline the workflow actually saves
calibration.hint: From your timed runs against the baseline. Closes the prediction you made in Module 1.

dimensions.name: Honest numbers
dimensions.criteria: Four metrics, each with a baseline and a would-do-differently answer. No theater; the cost line is present; the use metric is genuinely about downstream use.

dimensions.name: A rhythm that survives
dimensions.criteria: Blocks exist on a real calendar, sized to the maintenance fraction, with scripts runnable in a bad week. Skips are logged, not hidden.

dimensions.name: The retirement clause has teeth
dimensions.criteria: Triggers are specific enough that a reluctant future owner couldn't argue past them, and retirement is framed as an outcome, not a failure.

dimensions.name: Calibration
dimensions.criteria: The M1 reckoning is done with real numbers; the direction paragraph names a systematic bias and a concrete consequence for the next build.
